title: Quantum metrology via partial quantum error correction
summary: We introduce a quantum metrology scheme in which partial quantum error correction suppresses local noise while preserving sensitivity beyond the standard quantum limit. The probes are superpositions of energetically distinct stabilizer sectors, whose sensing coherence is protected by measuring only a subset of local checks. We propose an adaptive weight strategy to balance two competing effects.
